answers.basis: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required.
A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.
At the header on each odd page from page 3, a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required, but it is not necessary for “Editorial” or “Commentary and Perspective”.

answers.answer: 「[1,3,5-8]」のように、数字の前に「[」を、数字の後に「]」を書き、数字と「]」の間に句読点を置きます。
answers.basis: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends. When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.

answers.answer: 最初の6人の著者名を書き、その後に「et al.」と書きます。
answers.basis: For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by “et al.”

answers.answer: TIFF、PNG、JPEG、PDF形式のいずれかで、解像度は300 dpi以上。グラフィカルアブストラクトはPNG、JPEG、GIF形式で、解像度は300 dpi。
answers.basis:
We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats .
The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.

answers.answer:
1. 表はアラビア数字で通し番号を付ける。
2. 表のタイトルは表の上に付ける。
3. 表の脚注はa、b、c、…とアルファベットで付ける。
answers.basis:
Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals (for example “Table 3”), in the order of their appearance in the text.
Supply a short explanatory title above the body of the table, and table footnotes lettered a, b, c, and so forth, below the body of the table.
Do not use vertical lines.
The size of each file that is uploaded using the online submission system such as text, tables, figures and supplementary material (if any), should be no more than 20 MB.

answers.answer: 「New」、「Novel」、「First」、「Unprecedented」などの肯定的な言葉や、それらの形容詞
answers.basis: Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words, and their adjectives.
Authors who have been requested to revise their manuscript should send the revised version to the handling editor within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.
